rule.title: Uniform API Response Envelope
rule.statement: All API endpoints must return a standardized JSON envelope with consistent success and error schemas.
rule.rationale: Inconsistent response formats force frontend clients to implement disparate parsing logic, leading to runtime unhandled exceptions.
rule.implementation_guidance: Format success responses as { success: true, data: T } and error responses as { success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }.

forbidden.example: Returning a bare array [] on some routes and { result: ... } on other routes.

source.chapter: Chapter 4: Input Validation and Output Sanitization
source.evidence_quote: A consistent response envelope ensures that clients reliably distinguish between data payloads and error payloads, preventing parsing ambiguities and unintended data leakage.
